en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned panoramic view of a city near the sea, with a park or public square in the foreground, several buildings, and what appears to be a gazebo or pavilion. The text at the top is in Bulgarian and German, reading 'Поздравъ отъ Варна. — Ansicht von Varna.' (Greetings from Varna. — View of Varna.), with additional place and orientation annotations. The back of the card has handwritten addresses in Cyrillic and Latin, postmarks, and several stamps and official markings.
